# Resource: tfe_stack_variable_set

Manages associations between variable sets and stacks.

## Example Usage

```java
import software.constructs.*;
import com.hashicorp.cdktf.*;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import gen.providers.tfe.organization.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.stack.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.variableSet.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.stackVariableSet.*;
public class MyConvertedCode extends TerraformStack {
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, String name) {
        super(scope, name);
        Organization tfeOrganizationTest = new Organization(this, "test", new OrganizationConfig()
                .email("admin@company.com")
                .name("my-org-name")
                );
        Stack tfeStackTest = new Stack(this, "test_1", new StackConfig()
                .name("my-stack-name")
                .projectId(Token.asString(tfeOrganizationTest.getDefaultProjectId()))
                );
        /*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
        tfeStackTest.overrideLogicalId("test");
        VariableSet tfeVariableSetTest = new VariableSet(this, "test_2", new VariableSetConfig()
                .description("Some description.")
                .name("Test Varset")
                .organization(Token.asString(tfeOrganizationTest.getId()))
                );
        /*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
        tfeVariableSetTest.overrideLogicalId("test");
        StackVariableSet tfeStackVariableSetTest = new StackVariableSet(this, "test_3", new StackVariableSetConfig()
                .stackId(Token.asString(tfeStackTest.getId()))
                .variableSetId(Token.asString(tfeVariableSetTest.getId()))
                );
        /*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
        tfeStackVariableSetTest.overrideLogicalId("test");
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stackId` (String) The ID of the stack to which to add the variable set.
- `variableSetId` (String) The ID of the variable set to add to the stack.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the stack variable set association in the format `stack/varset`.



## Import

Resource tfe_stack_variable_set can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <STACK ID>/<VARSET ID>
terraform import tfe_stack_variable_set.test st-abcdefgh/varset-ijklmnop
```
